subject: Add CLAUDE.md to @zonoid/core package files so vendored installs can merge it
description: The new installClaudeInstructions() step in bin/install.js reads <INSTALL_DIR>/CLAUDE.md, but @zonoid/core's package.json `files` array omits CLAUDE.md, so the vendored tarball ships without it and the step silently no-ops in vendored installs (confirmed in HY_world: "source CLAUDE.md not found in install dir — skipping"). Fix: add "CLAUDE.md" to the `files` array in D:\PersonalProject\zonoid\package.json so npm pack includes it. Trivial config one-liner; no judge.
